message.content:
Elara found the antique music box hidden in her grandfather's attic. It was carved with scenes of a vibrant, forgotten summer. When she wound the tiny silver key, a melancholic waltz filled the dusty air, a rhythm of lost laughter.

A faded photograph slipped from the compartment. It showed a young man, smiling, holding her hand—her grandfather, whom she believed had died decades ago. 

The music swelled, impossibly sweet. He wasn't a ghost; he was a memory preserved in mahogany and sound. The box played on, a beautiful echo of a life rediscovered.
